entries.title: Psalms 30:1
segments:
PSALM XXX. 
 
  He praises God for delivering him, and exhorts others to praise him,   ver. 1-5.   Recollects his former security, and his prayer when in trouble,   ver. 6-10.   And stirs himself up to thankfulness, ver. 11, 12.   A Psalm and song, at the dedication of the house of David. 
 
Title of the psalm.  Song-A psalm to be sung with the voice to an instrument.  David-At the dedication of David's house, which was built,
, and doubtless was dedicated, as God had commanded.

entries.title: Psalms 30:5
segments: V. 5. Cometh-Speedily and in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 30:7
segments: V. 7. Mountain-My kingdom: kingdoms are usually called mountains in prophetical writings.

entries.title: Psalms 30:9
segments: V. 9. Profit-What wilt thou gain by it?  The dust-Shall they that are dead celebrate thy goodness in the land of the living?  Or, shall my dust praise thee?

entries.title: Psalms 30:11
segments: V. 11. Sackcloth-Given me occasion to put off that sackcloth, which they used to wear in times of mourning,
. Girded-With joy, as with a garment, surrounding me on every side.
